description: Differentiable soft-clDice for one-channel 2D probability masks and 3D volumes, using Shit et al. §2 Eqs. (1)–(2), §4.1 Algorithms 1–2 and Appendix G.2–G.3; per-sample batch reductions follow src/topologies/implementations/training/core.py:68-76.

examples.title: Train a binary tubular segmentation model with soft clDice

name: Soft clDice loss

parameters.epsilon: required positive finite real smoothing value added to both numerator and denominator in topology precision and sensitivity; the paper specifies no numeric default
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because binary foreground masks have no ignored class index
parameters.iterations: required nonnegative integer skeletonization iteration count k, chosen for the largest observed foreground radius; the paper specifies no default
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point probabilities in [0, 1] with shape [B, 1, H, W] or [B, 1, D, H, W]
parameters.reduction: none returns one loss per sample, mean averages samples, or sum adds samples (default mean)
parameters.targets: binary floating-point mask of 0 and 1 with the same shape, dtype, and device as logits_or_prediction
